PDFjet.NET

Class Chart

  • Object
    • PDFjet.NET.Chart
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    IDrawable

    public class Chart
extends Object
implements IDrawable
    Used to create XY chart objects and draw them on a page. Please see Example_09.
